exposure: Twin pregnancy in women with a unicornuate uterus
Singleton pregnancy in women with a unicornuate uterus
Twin pregnancy in women with a normal uterus
cohort: The study included 283 women who gave birth at West China Second University Hospital, Sichuan University between January 2013 and December 2022, divided into groups of twin pregnancies with a unicornuate uterus, singleton pregnancies with a unicornuate uterus, and twin pregnancies with a normal uterus.
finding: Twin pregnancies in women with a unicornuate uterus showed significantly higher rates of preterm premature rupture of membranes, preterm delivery, and NICU admission, as well as lower live birth weight, compared to singleton pregnancies with a unicornuate uterus and twin pregnancies with a normal uterus.
mod_finding: A high proportion (90.5%) of twin pregnancies in women with a unicornuate uterus underwent caesarean section.
birth_weight: Mean live birth weight in twin pregnancies with a unicornuate uterus was 1931.7 ± 535.2 g, which was lower than other groups.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery in twin pregnancies with a unicornuate uterus was 33.8 ± 5.7 weeks.
